games.desc:
Sonic.EXE: The Disaster Eclipsed v1.42

Sonic.EXE: The Disaster Eclipsed is a recreation of its predecessor [Sonic.EXE: The Disaster by Outlaik], with new survivors, new executioners and new abilities. 
Defend yourself as a survivor against the executioner with up to 6 friends, working together to survive until those who remain can escape. Or slaughter the opposing survivors as the executioner to prevent them from escaping.

Updated character info and a full changelog can be found to the left and back in the lobby.
Clunky gameplay and bugs may still be present, I'm still fixing it all as I go.
Bugfixes and additions to the game might be made, but more than one addition being made at a time is unlikely.
[This game may contain loud sounds and music]

A big thanks to the TD:Reborn team for the original game code, and to Outlaik for creating the original Sonic.EXE: The Disaster!
